_what: The grand plan's tag blocks (docs/GRAND-PLAN.md part 11, docs/plan/README.md). A card's letter to its blocks, each a first and a last number, both ends its own. A session takes its tags from its card's block, one a PR, in order. The numbers are bare on purpose: written with the version prefix, the tag check would read each as used.
_rules: A block is never written as a range in a commit's title (the tag check reads a range as every tag in it taken). A new card takes twenty from nextBlock and moves nextBlock on by twenty, in the PR that writes the card. A card that runs out takes a second block the same way. Blocks never overlap and are never handed back.
